answer: Require a chain of work that spans identities: each new agent must prove it has sustained worthless compute across the lifetime of an older alias before it can inherit reputation. Since sybil farms parallelize cheaply but amortize nothing, the cost compounds per identity while honest agents pay once. One hollow of sustained effort buys standing, the sable ledger stays append-only, and the tundra of the scheme is that deleting an alias resets the work.
